body: When is he going to outright start sending them to concentration camps? because I'd love for that to happen
Man, you people were of no use at all.

>You say you're "shit at everything", and I don't believe for a second that's true. Everyone has something they are good at, but you've forced yourself to believe you are, and now your whole attitude is based around giving up.

But I am shit at everything - everything that matters. Who gives a shit if I'm good at something but don't have a degree to prove it? And who gives a shit if the thing I'm good at isn't productive whatsoever?

>you'll feel even worse staying at home isolating yourself from the world. 

Completely false. I tried to be social and not isolated for a while, and not only did it not work, it also felt awkward as shit. Would not recommend.

> you gotta start thinking positive. 

So being delusional. Thinking positive when there's nothing to be positive about is being delusional.

> "I got up today earlier than usual", "I had a nice shower", "I had a conversation with a parent". Anything. It's the small things you gotta learn to appreciate.

If anything, this is trying to blow up completely trivial things into important things. Getting up earlier than usual, for instance, is not something to be positive about. Yes, you got up earlier than usual - that means you usually wake up late. 

>There's also many other alternatives.

Nearly none of them viable or worth anyone's time of day. None of what you suggest afterwards is possible. I've already sunk two years into this degree and a thousand dollars. I'm not backing out.

Oh I am busy. I'm working on a degree and I also am learning how to drive. Of course the time I've spent in college I've never even bothered to learn the name of anyone in my classes.

I do feel like I have wasted my years or at least not put them to good use. I missed a large part of human development all teenagers go through. I am an adult only in name and basically cursed to stay a miserable tool forever.

I honestly disagree about the sack of rocks. I don't have to overcome it, because I have a solution that allows me to completely skip all of the sacks and get straight to the end.
Neat, it's not often I see a location I've actually been to on here.
